primaryContext.candidateText: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
primaryContext.fixedText: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.

context.text: Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD appeared again in Shiloh; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD’s word.

primaryContext.candidateText: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
primaryContext.fixedText: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

context.text: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

wikipediaBodyRead.title: Beersheba
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: ベエル・シェバを聖書上の南端とし、テル・ベエル・シェバを現代市街から離れた聖書遺跡と説明。

geography.identityCheck: 3:20は「ダンからベエル・シェバまで」という南北範囲の表現、8:2は町に居住する裁判官の記述。地域表現と都市用例を区別する。
geography.uncertainty: 現代市と聖書時代の遺跡は別地点。従来候補座標は古代遺跡候補である可能性があるが、ここでは独立照合していない。
